segments.an8.8:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā uttaro mahisavatthusmiṃ viharati saṅkheyyake pabbate vaṭajālikāyaṃ [dhavajālikāyaṃ (sī.), vaṭṭajālikāyaṃ (syā.)].
segments.an8.8:1.2: Tatra kho āyasmā uttaro bhikkhū āmantesi –
segments.an8.8:1.3: “sādhāvuso, bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ attavipattiṃ paccavekkhitā hoti.
segments.an8.8:1.4: Sādhāvuso, bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ paravipattiṃ paccavekkhitā hoti.
segments.an8.8:1.5: Sādhāvuso, bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ attasampattiṃ paccavekkhitā hoti.
segments.an8.8:1.6: Sādhāvuso, bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ parasampattiṃ paccavekkhitā hotī”ti.
segments.an8.8:2.1: Tena kho pana samayena vessavaṇo mahārājā uttarāya disāya dakkhiṇaṃ disaṃ gacchati kenacideva karaṇīyena.
segments.an8.8:2.2: Assosi kho vessavaṇo mahārājā āyasmato uttarassa mahisavatthusmiṃ saṅkheyyake pabbate vaṭajālikāyaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ dhammaṃ desentassa –
segments.an8.8:2.3: “sādhāvuso, bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ attavipattiṃ paccavekkhitā hoti.
segments.an8.8:2.4: Sādhāvuso, bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ paravipattiṃ paccavekkhitā hoti.
segments.an8.8:2.5: Sādhāvuso, bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ attasampattiṃ paccavekkhitā hoti.
segments.an8.8:2.6: Sādhāvuso, bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ parasampattiṃ paccavekkhitā hotī”ti.
segments.an8.8:3.1: Atha kho vessavaṇṇo mahārājā – seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso samiñjitaṃ [sammiñjitaṃ (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ samiñjeyya [sammiñjeyya (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)], evamevaṃ mahisavatthusmiṃ saṅkheyyake pabbate vaṭajālikāyaṃ antarahito devesu tāvatiṃsesu pāturahosi.
segments.an8.8:3.2: Atha kho vessavaṇṇo mahārājā yena sakko devānamindo tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā sakkaṃ devānamindaṃ etadavoca –
segments.an8.8:3.4: Eso āyasmā uttaro mahisavatthusmiṃ saṅkheyyake pabbate vaṭajālikāyaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ dhammaṃ deseti –
segments.an8.8:3.5: ‘sādhāvuso, bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ attavipattiṃ paccavekkhitā hoti.
segments.an8.8:3.6: Sādhāvuso, bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ paravipattiṃ … pe … attasampattiṃ … parasampattiṃ paccavekkhitā hotī’”ti.
segments.an8.8:4.1: Atha kho sakko devānamindo seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso samiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ samiñjeyya, evamevaṃ devesu tāvatiṃsesu antarahito mahisavatthusmiṃ saṅkheyyake pabbate vaṭajālikāyaṃ āyasmato uttarassa sammukhe pāturahosi.
segments.an8.8:4.2: Atha kho sakko devānamindo yenāyasmā uttaro tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ uttaraṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho sakko devānamindo āyasmantaṃ uttaraṃ etadavoca –
segments.an8.8:5.1: “Saccaṃ kira, bhante, āyasmā uttaro bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ dhammaṃ desesi –
segments.an8.8:5.2: ‘sādhāvuso, bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ attavipattiṃ paccavekkhitā hoti, sādhāvuso, bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ paravipattiṃ … pe … attasampattiṃ … parasampattiṃ paccavekkhitā hotī’”ti?
segments.an8.8:5.7: “Kiṃ panidaṃ [kiṃ pana (syā.)], bhante, āyasmato uttarassa sakaṃ paṭibhānaṃ [sakapaṭibhānaṃ upādāya (ka.)], udāhu tassa bhagavato vacanaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassā”ti?
segments.an8.8:5.9: Upamāya midhekacce viññū purisā bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājānan”ti.
segments.an8.8:6.1: “Seyyathāpi, devānaminda, gāmassa vā nigamassa vā avidūre mahādhaññarāsi.
segments.an8.8:6.2: Tato mahājanakāyo dhaññaṃ āhareyya – kājehipi piṭakehipi ucchaṅgehipi añjalīhipi.
segments.an8.8:6.4: Yo nu kho, devānaminda, taṃ mahājanakāyaṃ upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ puccheyya –
segments.an8.8:6.5: ‘kuto imaṃ dhaññaṃ āharathā’ti, kathaṃ byākaramāno nu kho, devānaminda, so mahājanakāyo sammā byākaramāno byākareyyā”ti?
segments.an8.8:6.6: “‘Amumhā mahādhaññarāsimhā āharāmā’ti kho, bhante, so mahājanakāyo sammā byākaramāno byākareyyā”ti.
segments.an8.8:6.7: “Evamevaṃ kho, devānaminda, yaṃ kiñci subhāsitaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ tassa bhagavato vacanaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa.
segments.an8.8:6.8: Tato upādāyupādāya mayaṃ caññe ca bhaṇāmā”ti.
segments.an8.8:7.3: ‘yaṃ kiñci subhāsitaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ tassa bhagavato vacanaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa.
segments.an8.8:7.4: Tato upādāyupādāya mayaṃ caññe ca bhaṇāmā’ti.
segments.an8.8:7.5: Ekamidaṃ, bhante uttara, samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati gijjhakūṭe pabbate acirapakkante devadatte.
segments.an8.8:7.6: Tatra kho bhagavā devadattaṃ ārabbha bhikkhū āmantesi –
segments.an8.8:8.1: “Sādhu, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ attavipattiṃ paccavekkhitā hoti.
segments.an8.8:8.2: Sādhu, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ paravipattiṃ … pe … attasampattiṃ … parasampattiṃ paccavekkhitā hoti.
segments.an8.8:8.5: Aṭṭhahi, bhikkhave, asaddhammehi abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto devadatto āpāyiko nerayiko kappaṭṭho atekiccho.
segments.an8.8:8.7: Lābhena hi, bhikkhave, abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto devadatto āpāyiko nerayiko kappaṭṭho atekiccho;
segments.an8.8:8.8: alābhena, bhikkhave … pe … yasena, bhikkhave … ayasena, bhikkhave … sakkārena, bhikkhave … asakkārena, bhikkhave … pāpicchatāya, bhikkhave … pāpamittatāya, bhikkhave, abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto devadatto āpāyiko nerayiko kappaṭṭho atekiccho.
segments.an8.8:8.15: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, aṭṭhahi asaddhammehi abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto devadatto āpāyiko nerayiko kappaṭṭho atekiccho.
segments.an8.8:9.1: “Sādhu, bhikkhave, bhikkhu uppannaṃ lābhaṃ abhibhuyya abhibhuyya vihareyya;
segments.an8.8:9.2: uppannaṃ alābhaṃ … pe … uppannaṃ yasaṃ … uppannaṃ ayasaṃ … uppannaṃ sakkāraṃ … uppannaṃ asakkāraṃ … uppannaṃ pāpicchataṃ … uppannaṃ pāpamittataṃ abhibhuyya abhibhuyya vihareyya.
segments.an8.8:10.1: “Kiñca, bhikkhave, bhikkhu atthavasaṃ paṭicca uppannaṃ lābhaṃ abhibhuyya abhibhuyya vihareyya;
segments.an8.8:10.2: uppannaṃ alābhaṃ … pe … uppannaṃ yasaṃ … uppannaṃ ayasaṃ … uppannaṃ sakkāraṃ … uppannaṃ asakkāraṃ … uppannaṃ pāpicchataṃ … uppannaṃ pāpamittataṃ abhibhuyya abhibhuyya vihareyya?
segments.an8.8:11.1: “Yaṃ hissa, bhikkhave, uppannaṃ lābhaṃ anabhibhuyya viharato uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā, uppannaṃ lābhaṃ abhibhuyya viharato evaṃsa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti.
segments.an8.8:11.2: Yaṃ hissa, bhikkhave, uppannaṃ alābhaṃ … pe … uppannaṃ yasaṃ … uppannaṃ ayasaṃ … uppannaṃ sakkāraṃ … uppannaṃ asakkāraṃ … uppannaṃ pāpicchataṃ … uppannaṃ pāpamittataṃ anabhibhuyya viharato uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā, uppannaṃ pāpamittataṃ abhibhuyya viharato evaṃsa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti.
segments.an8.8:11.9: Idaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu atthavasaṃ paṭicca uppannaṃ lābhaṃ abhibhuyya abhibhuyya vihareyya;
segments.an8.8:11.10: uppannaṃ alābhaṃ … pe … uppannaṃ yasaṃ … uppannaṃ ayasaṃ … uppannaṃ sakkāraṃ … uppannaṃ asakkāraṃ … uppannaṃ pāpicchataṃ … uppannaṃ pāpamittataṃ abhibhuyya abhibhuyya vihareyya.
segments.an8.8:12.1: “Tasmātiha, bhikkhave, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ – uppannaṃ lābhaṃ abhibhuyya abhibhuyya viharissāma, uppannaṃ alābhaṃ … pe … uppannaṃ yasaṃ … uppannaṃ ayasaṃ … uppannaṃ sakkāraṃ … uppannaṃ asakkāraṃ … uppannaṃ pāpicchataṃ … uppannaṃ pāpamittataṃ abhibhuyya abhibhuyya viharissāmāti.
segments.an8.8:13.1: “Ettāvatā, bhante uttara, manussesu catasso parisā – bhikkhū, bhikkhuniyo, upāsakā, upāsikāyo.
segments.an8.8:13.4: Uggaṇhatu, bhante, āyasmā uttaro imaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ.
segments.an8.8:13.5: Pariyāpuṇātu, bhante, āyasmā uttaro imaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ.
segments.an8.8:13.6: Dhāretu, bhante, āyasmā uttaro imaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ.
segments.an8.8:13.7: Atthasaṃhito ayaṃ, bhante, dhammapariyāyo ādibrahmacariyako”ti [ādibrahmacariyiko (sī. ka.)].

lines: So kira vaṭavane niviṭṭhattā vaṭajālikāti saṅkhaṃ gato.
Pāturahosīti imamatthaṃ devarañño ārocessāmīti gantvā pākaṭo ahosi.
6-8. Chaṭṭhe adhikaṃ payasati payujjati etenāti adhippayāso, savisesaṃ itikattabbakiriyā.
